mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.client_name FROM project p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.client_name IS NOT NULL AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE st.project_id = p.project_id AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY p.client_name ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT nb.project_id AS project_id, MIN(nb.planned_date) AS planned_date FROM ( SELECT st.project_id AS project_id, sb.round_no AS round_no, sb.planned_date AS planned_date FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb.status != 'COMPLETED' ) nb JOIN ( SELECT st2.project_id AS project_id, MIN(sb2.round_no) AS min_round_no FROM settlement_block sb2 JOIN block b2 ON b2.block_id = sb2.block_id JOIN step st2 ON st2.step_id = b2.step_id WHERE sb2.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb2.status != 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY st2.project_id ) mr ON mr.project_id = nb.project_id AND mr.min_round_no = nb.round_no GROUP BY nb.project_id ) nxt ON nxt.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.client_name = #{client} AND p.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') AND nxt.planned_date >= #{startDate} AND nxt.planned_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT sb.settle_id AS settleId, sb.round_no AS roundNo, b.title AS roundName, sb.planned_date AS plannedDate, sb.planned_amount AS plannedAmount, sb.planned_tax_amount AS plannedTaxAmount, ti.issued_no AS taxInvoiceDate, sb.planned_tax_amount AS taxInvoiceAmount, sb.type AS paidType, sb.bank_name AS bankName, sb.account_number AS accountNumber, sb.account_holder AS accountHolder, DATE(sb.actual_date) AS paidDate, sb.actual_amount AS paidAmount, sb.status AS status, ti.linked_by AS taxLinkedBy, tie.name AS taxLinkedByName, ti.linked_at AS taxLinkedAt, cf.linked_by AS cashFlowLinkedBy, cfe.name AS cashFlowLinkedByName, cf.linked_at AS cashFlowLinkedAt FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = st.project_id LEFT JOIN tax_invoice ti ON ti.tax_id = ( SELECT ti2.tax_id FROM tax_invoice ti2 WHERE ti2.settle_block_id = sb.settle_id AND ti2.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ti2.linked_at DESC, ti2.tax_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN employee tie ON tie.user_id = ti.linked_by LEFT JOIN cash_flow cf ON cf.cash_flow_id = ( SELECT cf2.cash_flow_id FROM cash_flow cf2 WHERE cf2.settle_block_id = sb.settle_id AND cf2.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cf2.linked_at DESC, cf2.cash_flow_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN employee cfe ON cfe.user_id = cf.linked_by WHERE st.project_id = #{projectId} AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY (sb.round_no IS NULL) ASC, sb.round_no ASC, sb.settle_id ASC
